articles.title: President Trump to U.S. Car Makers: ‘Let China Come.’
articles.mainIdea: President Trump to U.S. Car Makers: ‘Let China Come.’
articles.summary: Barrons.com: President Trump to U.S. Car Makers: ‘Let China Come.’. President Trump visited Detroit, Michigan, on Tuesday, in the heart of the American auto industry. “Let China come in,” said Trump at one point, a statement that might raise eyebrows for American auto executives. China has low-cost sources of parts and labor, and its BYD is now the largest seller of all-electric cars globally, topping Tesla for the first time in 2025. Related tickers mentioned: BYDDF, F, TSLA, ^DJI, ^GSPC.
